fields.label: Intro
paragraphs: Agricultural machinery sits outdoors year-round. Compound choice is driven by UV and ozone exposure, chemical contact and abrasive contamination rather than indoor service assumptions.
fields.note: [no change] — 26 words that state the selection logic correctly. The cards below are where the figures go

fields.label: Card 1 — UV & Ozone Resistance
paragraphs: EPDM for components in continuous outdoor exposure — −40 °C to +140 °C, 40 to 90 Shore A — where general-purpose rubber perishes. Ozone resistance is one of the tests we run in-house, so a weathering specification can be checked before release rather than after a season in the field.
fields.note: 44 words · live is 20 · the temperature range and the in-house ozone test are the additions. Ozone is on the published test list; naming it here is the difference between a claim and a capability. “Weather-grade compounds” is dropped — it is not a grade of anything

fields.label: Card 2 — Abrasion & Contamination
paragraphs: Natural rubber — the best abrasion resistance of the eight compounds we mix — with sealed geometries for soil, grit and organic contamination. We supply moulded components — bushes, boots, seals and mounts — and rubber sheet lining for hoppers, chutes and tanks.
leads: We supply moulded components — bushes, boots, seals and mounts — and rubber sheet lining for hoppers, chutes and tanks.
fields.note: 40 words · live is 14 · naming the compound is the point. “High-abrasion compounds” is a category, not a claim; natural rubber with a reason is both more useful and more defensible. Word for word the same range statement as the mining and pumps & valves sheets (lining client-confirmed 2026-09-02), so three pages describe one capability identically

fields.label: Card 3 — Temperature Swing
paragraphs: Compounds selected to stay flexible across seasonal extremes rather than a narrow operating band — EPDM −40 to +140 °C, neoprene −40 to +120 °C, natural rubber −20 to +90 °C. Below −20 °C natural rubber stiffens, and a linkage bush that was compliant in summer will not be on a cold start.
leads: EPDM −40 to +140 °C, neoprene −40 to +120 °C, natural rubber −20 to +90 °C
fields.note: 50 words · live is 17 · three ranges, then the consequence. Figures match the homepage compound table. The cold-start sentence is what makes the card useful — it names the failure a buyer in a cold climate will actually see

fields.label: Card 4 — Shock & Vibration
paragraphs: Mount geometry tuned for rough-terrain shock loading rather than smooth-running industrial duty. Send the supported mass, the mounting orientation and the disturbing frequency — rate is set by geometry and hardness together, and a mount specified from hardness alone is a guess.
leads: Send the supported mass, the mounting orientation and the disturbing frequency
fields.note: 42 words · live is 15 · adds the three inputs and why they are asked for. Same request as the anti-vibration mounts product sheet, so the two pages ask for the same things in the same order

fields.label: Compliance note
paragraphs: Buyers are responsible for confirming applicable import duties and any phytosanitary requirements for their specific order.

Buyers are responsible for confirming applicable import duties for their specific order. Where timber packaging is used, consignments are shipped with ISPM-15 treated and marked pallets and a fumigation certificate. Kenya and Tanzania both require pre-shipment verification of conformity (PVoC) through an approved inspection body before departure — we supply the technical file and arrange inspection at the Nashik facility.
leads: Where timber packaging is used, consignments are shipped with ISPM-15 treated and marked pallets and a fumigation certificate.
fields.note:
59 words · live is 16 · this is the correction the page most needs. Phytosanitary certification applies to plants and plant products — seeds, timber, produce, soil. A moulded rubber bush is none of those and will never need one. The word is on the page because the sector is agriculture, which is the kind of association error a knowledgeable importer notices immediately.
The two requirements that do apply are named instead: ISPM-15 on the wooden pallet, not on the rubber — the same standard the mining sheet raises for Australia — and PVoC for Kenya and Tanzania, which the export sheet already documents. A wrong word becomes the two most useful sentences on the page

Do not schema PVoC or ISPM-15. Both are processes, not credentials Margo holds; in structured data they would read as certifications.
Country names are text, not flag images. Flags without text nodes are invisible to extraction and ambiguous to a screen reader.
Link “full export documentation” to /export and the PVoC sentence to the export page section that covers it — the deepest useful internal link on the page.

fields.label: Q1
paragraphs: EPDM is the usual choice for weather-exposed components, for its UV and ozone resistance across −40 °C to +140 °C. Natural rubber blends are used where abrasion resistance matters more than weathering, at −20 °C to +90 °C. Ozone resistance is tested in-house before release.
fields.note: 42 words · live is 32 · two ranges and the in-house test added. Sits in the 40–60 word extraction band

fields.label: Q2
paragraphs: Compound selection is driven by the specific chemistry in contact. Send the chemical, concentration and service temperature and we will recommend a compound. Send the concentrate as well as the diluted spray — a compound that holds against a field dilution may not hold in the mixing tank.
leads: Send the concentrate as well as the diluted spray — a compound that holds against a field dilution may not hold in the mixing tank.
fields.note: 49 words · live is 26 · the live answer is already the best FAQ answer in the whole set — it refuses to guess and asks for the three inputs that decide it. The addition is the one thing it misses, and it is the thing that actually fails

fields.label: Q3
paragraphs: 500 pieces per part number, per material. Catalogue sizes ship in 14 to 21 days ex-works Nashik from drawing approval.

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum. Lead time is confirmed with the quotation, from approved drawing and approved sample.
leads: The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound
fields.note:
48 words · live is 21 · client instruction, 2026-09-01. Fifth industry page with a dedicated minimum-order FAQ and the number was wrong in the other direction. The lead time goes too — “catalogue sizes” contradicts a page that says twice that nothing is supplied from a catalogue, and 14 to 21 days is not a promise any drawing-matched moulder can make before tooling is settled.
On this sector the corrected answer qualifies buyers in, not out. An agricultural OEM ordering linkage bushes orders them by the tens of thousands

fields.label: Q4
paragraphs: Yes. Bellows and boots are quoted against convolution count, free and compressed length, diameter, flex-cycle target and service temperature. We hold the geometry and the compound; the cycle life is proved by your rig or a third-party laboratory, and we will support that test.
leads: We hold the geometry and the compound; the cycle life is proved by your rig or a third-party laboratory, and we will support that test.
fields.note: 48 words · live is 24 · asking for the flex-cycle target is right; the addition is how it is answered. Margo publishes no fatigue rig, and De Mattia flex testing to ISO 132, ASTM D430 or ASTM D813 is what a cycle-life number would have to come from. Same position as the bellows product sheet

fields.label: Q5
paragraphs: Yes. Send the physical sample or the equipment make and model and we will produce a drawing and confirm compound selection. A worn part measures smaller than it was made — we dimension to the original intent, not to the wear, and confirm the result with you before tooling.
leads: A worn part measures smaller than it was made
fields.note: 50 words · live is 25 · the addition is the part a reverse-engineering buyer worries about and almost nobody publishes: copying a worn sample reproduces the wear. Saying it is both reassuring and true

fields.label: Q6 — new
paragraphs: We hold ISO 9001:2015 — certificate 09111526A, issued by Integral Certification Ltd, valid to 21 February 2027. An IATF 16949:2016 upgrade is in progress, targeted for completion by the end of 2026. ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 are targeted for 2027. Documentation is available on request.
leads: An IATF 16949:2016 upgrade is in progress, targeted for completion by the end of 2026.
fields.note: 47 words · new sixth question — tell the developer the accordion grows by one row. Agricultural OEMs run automotive-style supplier audits and the question is asked on every one of them. Same answer as the other eight industry sheets
